You shake your head slowly. "Not today."

 "I'm still considering it."

 The pirate nods slowly. "Very well. Three million remains today's storage and maintenance fee." He points a finger at the screen. "Today being the important word there."

The transmission terminates, leaving Bagele looking only slightly less worried than before.

A few seconds later, a huge smile spreads across {TGT_MW.Det} face as {TGT_MW.Subj} picks up the pitcher of [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_GhostBeer],Ghost Beer]] and refills both tankards, "You are the Commander, and you have declared we wait. We shall wait until the time is right Commander, quiaff?" You reluctantly grab your tankard and clink it against {TGT_MW.Det} raised tankard, "Aff, MechWarrior."
危险选项: 你平静地看向[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]：“听着，我很感谢你的请求，也知道公司若能添一台氏族突击机甲会很不错，但我们手头的事情太多，现在根本抽不出精力执行回收任务。希望你能理解。” 沉默持续着。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]一动不动地盯着你，让你渐渐感到有些不自在。几秒后，{TGT_MW.Det}脸上忽然绽开灿烂的笑容，{TGT_MW.Subj}拿起一壶[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_GhostBeer],幽灵啤酒]]，给两只酒杯都倒满。“你是指挥官，既然你决定等待，我们就等到时机成熟再行动，指挥官，是吧？” 你不情愿地拿起酒杯，与{TGT_MW.Det}举起的酒杯碰了一下：“是的，机甲战士。”

risky:
You find MiG in the barracks, seated on the edge of a bunk, strapping his neurohelmet's padding into place. He glances up as you step in, his expression as unreadable as ever.

"MiG," you say. "Welcome back."

He nods once. "Good to be back."

You pull up your datapad, scrolling through the assignment logs. "You know the drill. Every pilot gets a ride that fits their style. You've been with us before, but let's make it official—what weight class are you currently running?"

MiG doesn't answer right away. He tilts his head slightly, considering the question. His fingers drum once against the side of the helmet. Then, finally, he looks up and says...
危险选项:
你在营房里找到MiG。他坐在床沿，正把神经头盔的衬垫固定好。你走进来时，他抬头看了你一眼，神情一如既往地难以捉摸。

“MiG，”你说，“欢迎回来。”

他点了点头。“回来真好。”

你调出数据板，翻看任务记录。“你知道规矩。每位驾驶员都会配一台适合自己风格的机甲。你以前和我们并肩作战过，不过这次还是正式确认一下：你现在想驾驶哪个吨位级别的机甲？”

MiG没有立刻回答。他微微歪头，认真考虑这个问题，手指在头盔侧面轻敲了一下。最后，他抬起头说道……

St Burt looks calm and collected as he disembarks the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_BRV],Heavy BRV]] and strides over to where you are standing, "Well Commander, there are still a few glitches that need to be worked out of some of the systems. The Astechs assure me it will not take long and I can do another test exercise." The silence seems to last forever before Darius interrupts your thoughts, "Commander, are we staying put to run another test?"
危险选项: 你也说不清究竟是哪里出了问题，但看着回收队把冒烟的最后仪式拖回控制掩体，你开始怀疑这个副项目到底值不值得投入这么多时间。 圣伯特看起来镇定自若。他从[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[Lore_BRV],重型 BRV]]上下来，大步走到你面前。“指挥官，部分系统还需要排除几个故障。技术员保证很快就能修好，我之后还可以再做一次测试演习。” 沉默仿佛持续了很久，达利乌斯终于打断了你的思绪：“指挥官，我们要留下来再做一次测试吗？”

risky:
As much as it pains you, you approve the payment, "Very well, we will pay your fee." The look of disappointment on Sumire's face echoes that of the rest of the bridge crew.

The shimmering figures claps their hands, "Excellent!  You are wise beyond your years, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}.  Feel free to pop by anytime."

As the pirate ships disappear into the starry distance, you turn to Darius, "Still no updates as to who they are?"

Darius looks up from his panel and shrugs, "Same as before Commander, Jamie Rayson and Mr Bubbles were a formidable team, and current rumors suggest that he will not stop until she is found."
危险选项:
尽管心里很不是滋味，你还是批准了付款：“好吧，我们会支付你的费用。”苏米尔脸上的失望，与舰桥上其他船员如出一辙。

闪烁的人影拍起手来：“太好了！指挥官{COMMANDER.LastName}，您年纪轻轻就如此明智，随时欢迎再来。”

海盗舰船消失在星海深处后，你转向达利乌斯：“还是没有关于他们身份的消息？”

达利乌斯抬头看了看控制面板，耸耸肩：“和之前一样，指挥官。Jamie Rayson和Bubbles先生曾是非常强悍的搭档。目前的传闻说，他不找到她就不会罢休。”

risky:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] is quarantined in one of the MedBays and provided a generic symptomatic treatment. {TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is} soon joined by [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]], and not long after that, [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]] falls ill as well.

Rumors and fear spread faster than the virus, with stories of disfiguring boils, raging fevers, and delirium. Everyone finds themselves praying to whatever gods they worship.

Eventually, it is clear the quarantine has successfully limited the spread of the disease. Unfortunately, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] was too far gone for the treatment to reverse the effects of the pathogen.  For [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] and [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]], however, the road to recovery will be extremely long and unpleasant.
危险选项:
[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]在一间医疗舱里接受隔离，并接受了常规的对症治疗。不久之后，{TGT_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:are|Default:is}很快也加入了[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]的行列，没过多久，[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]也病倒了。

病毒尚未蔓延，谣言和恐慌却先一步扩散开来。毁容的脓疱、高烧和神志不清等骇人传闻四处流传，每个人都开始向自己信奉的神明祈祷。

隔离最终成功控制了疾病的传播。不幸的是，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]病情太重，治疗已经无法逆转病原体造成的损害。至于[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]和[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]，他们的康复之路则会极其漫长而难熬。

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] steps forward, "Commander, I would like to participate in the upcoming fight. The ultimate goal is rebuilding Last Rites and I need to be do my part for {COMPANY.CompanyName}." You nod your head, "You are more than welcome to participate [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]." ATTACK DEFEND CONTRACT: LAST RITES, ADDED TO COMMAND CENTER

risky:
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] knocks on your open doorway, "Commander {Commander.FIRSTNAME} {Commander.LASTNAME}, you have a moment to see me, quiaff?"

At the sound of the knock, you look up from your monitor, "Yes, yes, come in.  What's on your mind MechWarrior?"

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] moves over to stand in front of your desk, "Commander {Commander.FIRSTNAME} {Commander.LASTNAME}, I am again formally requesting your permission to depart {COMPANY.CompanyName}."

You sigh, knowing this moment was coming, "You are really dead set determined to go on your vision quest or whatever it's called?"

"Aff, Commander {Commander.FIRSTNAME} {Commander.LASTNAME}," [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]].  "As I said before, I have something I must do as Star Adder, and it does not involve this company.  You will grant me the right to leave this time, quiaff?”
危险选项:
[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]敲了敲你敞开的办公室门。“指挥官{Commander.FIRSTNAME} {Commander.LASTNAME}，现在方便谈谈吗？”

听到敲门声，你从显示器前抬起头：“方便，进来吧。有什么事，机甲战士？”

[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]走到你的办公桌前。“指挥官{Commander.FIRSTNAME} {Commander.LASTNAME}，我再次正式请求您批准我离开{COMPANY.CompanyName}。”

你叹了口气，知道这一刻迟早会来：“你还是铁了心要去完成你的寻道之旅，或者不管你们怎么称呼它？”

“是的，指挥官{Commander.FIRSTNAME} {Commander.LASTNAME}。”[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]说道，“正如我之前所说，身为星辰蝰蛇，我有必须完成的事，而且与这家公司无关。这次您会批准我离开，对吗？”

risky: "Your tenacity in looking into this is commendable," you say to Dr. Murad over the intercom, "I have no doubt you will find a way of tracking this down." Dr Murad responds, "I know the noise is coming from something in Navigation, There are too many other sounds to accurately pinpoint the origin though. If I don't find the cause, we won't be getting much sleep Commander." Suddenly, the knocking noise stops. "Did you find out the cause?" you ask. Dr Murad sounds surprised, "No Commander, I have no more insight than I did when it started." You yawn loudly, "I'm going back to sleep. Keep me posted."
危险选项: “你如此坚持调查这件事，值得肯定。”你通过通讯器对穆拉德博士说，“我相信你一定能找到追查噪声来源的办法。” 穆拉德博士回答：“我知道噪声来自导航系统里的某处，但其他声音太多，没法准确锁定源头。要是查不出来，我们恐怕都睡不了多少觉，指挥官。” 突然，敲击声停了。 “找到原因了吗？”你问道。 穆拉德博士听起来有些惊讶：“没有，指挥官。我现在知道的和声音刚响起时一样多。” 你打了个大哈欠：“我回去睡了。有消息随时告诉我。”

risky:
You you steel yourself as you deliver the bad news, "I was afraid you would want to rejoin {COMPANY.CompanyName}.  Unfortunately, things have changed since you were last with us.  We have members of the crew now that would make things complicated if you were to join us.  Perhaps another time things will change again in your favour."

Bearing frowns, "This is not optimal, Commander {COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}.  Very well.  I will make my own way for now.  Perhaps we will cross paths in the future and things will be more... accommodating."

As he stands and heads out of the bar, you hope you get another chance to have him back in the company.
危险选项:
你强忍着难受，说出坏消息：“我猜你会想重返{COMPANY.CompanyName}。遗憾的是，从你上次离开后情况变了。现在船员里有些人会让你加入后变得很复杂。也许以后情况会再次好转。”

Bearing皱起眉头：“这不是最佳结果，指挥官{COMMANDER.FirstName} {COMMANDER.LastName}。好吧，我暂时自己想办法。也许我们将来还会再遇上，到那时情况会更……方便些。”

看着他站起身离开酒吧，你希望以后还能有机会让他重返公司。

Darius consults the datapad, "Well, according to them, we have been cited for..."

risky: Leaning back in your chair, you look up at the drunks nonchalantly, 'We not only saved the Inner Sphere but the Pirate Queen personally praised us and offered us jobs as one of her minions.'
